verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, a hardware component, not software that acts as an MCP client. Plugging MCP servers in so the product can call their tools is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the processor or its Ryzen Master utility acting as an MCP client, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
